result:
My verdict is **PASS** on candidate `sha256:56415aee…` (source `cde60365`), with no new findings. Both records validate against the review schema, and every cited evidence file exists:

- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-10/code-security-reviewer.json`
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-10/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`

**Open findings, verified on this candidate:**

| Item | Result | How it was shown |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG6-540 (Medium; inbox names hidden records), including round-9 observation 600 (digest read not redacted) | CLOSED_VERIFIED | My round-8 inbox probe passes 5/5 with no leaks. My round-9 digest probe now passes: the digest item comes back as the restricted text. Mutants that remove the redaction from mark-read, from the digest, or add a new unredacted serializer are all caught. |
| F-DG6-541 (Medium; removing a condition loses a hidden literal) | CLOSED_VERIFIED | My round-8 probe passes and the hidden value stays stored. Bare, unknown and look-alike markers are refused with 422. The mutant that stores an unknown token is caught. |
| F-DG6-580, same defect as my round-9 observation 601 (stale tokens re-sent by the editor) | CLOSED_VERIFIED | The three round-9 failure cases now each get 422 `restricted_token_stale`, and the hidden values stay. The editor's second save now sends the current version's token. A new real-browser probe passes in English and Arabic (see below). Mutants that drop the version check or the editor reloads are caught. |

The real-browser probe on the production-initialized stack covered two flows:
- **Double save:** the hidden value is kept.
- **Concurrent edit:** the save gets 409, the "changed, re-apply" banner appears, the form reloads, and the re-applied save keeps the hidden value.

No screen showed the hidden record's id or title.

All 8 mutants were caught by assertions. One limit to note: a mutant that keeps the redaction helpers' names but makes them do nothing passes the in-tree source-scan test, because that test only checks the names. The digest integration test still catches it.

**Open questions from D-232:** I accept D-229 and D-228 (4), and found no defect:
- **D-229:** connector configuration names are SecretRef names, and field mappings are text that an administrator types and that connector readers already see. Error text and error parameters are masked.
- **D-228 (4):** the hidden-id check only considers records marked in the reader's own organization. The cross-organization sweep passes: 312 operations answer 403 or 404 and nothing is saved.
- **Review of the round 8→9 and 9→10 diffs:** no gap. A refused token's value is never echoed back, and conditions only support exact matching, so the dry run can't be used to guess a hidden id piece by piece. Audit events are redacted when read.

**Required checks:** all pass. These are build, typecheck, lint, format, openapi:lint (932 operations), no-cdn, `pnpm test` on Node 22 and Node 24, and the integration suite with `LANG` unset and with `C.UTF-8`, plus the historical validation of DG5 to DG1. `contract.test.ts` asserts 932 operations. Migrations `0098`–`0126` are contiguous and none was modified; note that the assignment says `0125`, but `0126` exists.

**First-run failures, all environmental and all disclosed in the record:**
- **Disk full:** the disk shared with the other two reviewers filled up. That failed one web unit file on Node 24 and several shard-1 integration files in both locales. Each passes when re-run alone, unmodified.
- **Out of memory:** typecheck was killed twice, and integration shard 3 crashed in both locales. The typecheck passes run alone, and shard 3 passes in full in both locales (1316/1316).
- **Timeouts under load:** one Node 22 test (`architecture.test.ts`) timed out, and Vitest reported internal worker timeouts. A quiet re-run passes 2902/2902.
- **My own leftover:** format:check failed once on my probe file left in the clone. It is not a candidate file, and the re-run passes.

**Not re-run by me:**
- **Load proofs (REQ-S20-029/030):** I did not re-run the full-dataset load measurements, because the shared disk could not hold them. The assignment classes these as a production-capacity residual, so I recorded them on the offline tests, which pass.
- **e2e:** the A12/A17 end-to-end specs were run by the orchestrator, not by me.

**Housekeeping:**
- **Round number:** the record uses round 10, not the assignment's "round: 7". The validator requires the round to match the directory.
- **Scratch clean-up denied:** the permission system refused my attempt to delete test scratch folders in my temp directory. The runner removes that directory when the run ends.

**New findings:** none.
